transcript: Most business owners open Claude, ask a question, and miss 90% of what it can do. Here are three things you should do the second you open up Claude. Number one is open up Claude, come down to the bottom, and come into settings. Then underneath general and profile, you're going to see instructions for Claude. Go to share a little bit about who you are and what you're wanting to accomplish. Number two is come into co-work, and right here where it says work in a project, come all the way down and create a new project. This will be a folder on your computer that you can upload documents like branding guides, sales scripts, or whatever might be helpful to Claude. And number three, come and click on customize. This will allow you to connect to different apps that you can then use inside of Claude. Hit this video and follow for more.
